name: Camp Onaway
description_short: A traditional residential summer camp for girls ages 9 to 15 on Newfound Lake in Hebron, NH, since 1911. The main program is a 7-week session for rising 5th to 10th graders, with 3-week Wendies sessions for rising 4th graders.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Newfound Lake. Every camper has daily swimming instruction; campers progress through boating, then canoeing, and add crew in their final two years. Sailing is scheduled for all campers.

source.title: Dates, Tuition, and Enrollment – Camp Onaway

The camp has two phone numbers: 603-744-2180 for the summer office in Hebron (June–August) and 610-525-0676 for the year-round office in Glenside, PA.
Girls only. Returning campers get first choice of spots.
